# laravel_cloud_dedicated_clusters (Data Source)

Lists dedicated clusters available to your organization.

- `clusters` (Attributes List) Available dedicated clusters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
